1) In absence of Appellate Authority as provided under Section 70 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (for short 'the Act') present petition came to be filed challenging an order passed by the Adjudicating Officer and Resident Additional Collector, District - Bhuj-Kutchh dated 12.09.2014,
which is otherwise appealable before the Appellate Tribunal.
2) Since now Appellate Tribunal under Section 70 of 'the Act', is available with the State Government at Gandhinagar, the present petition is transferred to the Appellate Tribunal constituted under Section 70 of 'the Act' at Gandhinagar.
3) The Appellate Tribunal shall conduct the proceedings NEUTRAL CITATION R/SCR.A/5118/2014 ORDER DATED: 02/01/2025 undefined registering it as appeal in accordance with law.
